title: Writing Clean Python Code
overview: Clean code is easy to read, understand, and maintain. Python developers follow certain practices to keep applications organized and efficient.

example.title: Clean Code Practices
example.content:
✔ Meaningful variable names
✔ Proper indentation
✔ Avoid unnecessary code
✔ Write reusable functions

title: Follow Python Naming Conventions
overview: Python uses naming conventions like snake_case for variables and functions to keep code consistent and readable.

title: Use Virtual Environments
overview: Virtual environments isolate project dependencies and prevent conflicts between different Python projects.

example.title: Virtual Environment
example.content:
Create:
python -m venv env

Activate environment before installing packages.

title: Handle Errors Properly
overview: Proper exception handling prevents applications from crashing and helps developers identify problems easily.

example.title: Error Handling

title: Project Organization
overview: A well-structured Python project separates files based on responsibilities, making development and maintenance easier.

example.title: Project Structure
example.content:
project/
 ├── app.py
 ├── models/
 ├── services/
 ├── utils/
 └── tests/

title: Topic Summary
overview: You learned important Python development practices including clean code, naming conventions, environments, error handling, and project organization.

example.title: Quick Revision
example.content:
